Diamond shape refers to `the outer geometric outline of a gemstone when viewed from above, divided into traditional round cuts and alternative fancy shapes`.[[1]](https://www.tiffany.com/engagement/diamond-education/diamond-shapes.html)[[2]](https://www.doamore.com/diamond-shapes-10-shapes-to-compare-before-you-buy/)

### Main Diamond Shapes

- **Round:** The most popular and classic choice, known for maximum sparkle.
- **Princess:** A square or rectangular shape with sharp, pointed corners and brilliant facets.
- **Oval:** An elongated rounded shape that creates a large surface look on the finger.
- **Cushion:** A square or rectangular shape with rounded corners and larger facets for a soft, antique look.
- **Emerald:** A rectangular step-cut with trimmed corners that creates a clear "hall of mirrors" visual.
- **Pear:** A teardrop shape combining a rounded end with a single sharp point.
- **Marquise:** An elongated shape with pointed ends at both sides to maximize perceived size.
- **Radiant:** A square or rectangular shape with trimmed corners and high-sparkle faceting.
- **Asscher:** A square step-cut with deeply cropped corners and concentric square facets.
- **Heart:** A unique symbol shape cut in the unmistakable outline of a heart.[[1]](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/blog/guide-diamond-shapes-engagement-rings/)[[2]](https://www.kay.com/different-diamond-shapes)[[3]](https://www.doamore.com/diamond-shapes-10-shapes-to-compare-before-you-buy/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/glJOyD37xKQ)[[5]](https://billigjewelers.com/blogs/guide/diamond-shape-guide)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P8gdsCgpD1w&t=388)

### Shape Versus Cut

- **Shape** is only the physical silhouette or external outline of the stone.
- **Cut** measures how well the stone's internal facets interact with light to produce brilliance and fire.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/diamond-shape/)[[2]](https://www.doamore.com/diamond-shapes-10-shapes-to-compare-before-you-buy/)

If you are shopping for a piece, tell me:

- What **item** are you looking for (engagement ring, pendant, earrings)?
- Do you prefer a **classic** style like round or a **unique** shape like pear or oval?
- What is your target **carat weight or budget range**?

I can help you narrow down the best options.

items.title: How does diamond cut affect its price?

expanded_element.title: Does Diamond Cut Affect Price I VRAI
expanded_element.snippet: The Diamond cut price difference for diamonds with the same cut quality and carat weight often comes down to the diamond shape. The more popular and rare the diamond shape, the more it will cost. Round Brilliant cut diamonds are the most popular diamond shape, so they usually cost more than other diamond shapes.
related_searches: How does diamond cut affect its price?

items.title: How does diamond cut affect its brilliance?

expanded_element.title: Diamond Cut Guide: Understanding Cut Grade & Quality - VRAI
expanded_element.snippet: A high-quality cut invites maximum light for breathtaking brilliance, fire, and scintillation. Diamond cut influences how large, brilliant, and lustrous your diamond appears. It can make a lower-color-grade lab-grown diamond shine brighter or cause a nearly-flawless diamond to appear dull.
related_searches: How does diamond cut affect its brilliance?

expanded_element.title: Education & Diamond Cut Grades | Tiffany & Co. US
expanded_element.snippet: Diamond cut is determined by symmetry, proportion and polish. Diamond cutting is the process of turning a rough stone into a faceted one. More than any other factor, cut determines the beauty of the stone. Tiffany diamonds, from the smallest to the largest stone, are cut to exacting standards.
